name: Stripe
summary: Stripe is a payment processor that lets your app accept credit card and other online payments.

free_plan_covers.note: No monthly fee or user cap; you only pay per successful transaction (2.9% + 30 cents for US cards).

first_paid_usd_month.note: No monthly plan for standard Payments; pricing is pay-per-transaction with no setup or monthly fees.

portability.note: Proprietary API, but its checkout and webhook model is the format most competitors document a migration path from.

merchant_of_record.note: Standard Stripe Payments is not merchant of record. Stripe Tax only calculates tax; the separate Managed Payments product is MoR for an extra 3.5% fee.

subscriptions.note: Recurring billing is supported through the Stripe Billing product, priced separately from base payment fees.

fee_summary.value: 2.9% + 30 cents per successful US card charge
fee_summary.note: Domestic card rate; manually entered cards add 0.5% and international cards add 1.5%.

setup.step: Create a Stripe account and get your publishable and secret API keys from the dashboard.
Install the libraries with npm install stripe @stripe/stripe-js.
Set your publishable, secret, and webhook signing keys as environment variables.
Create a Checkout Session in a server route handler and redirect the customer to its URL.
Add a webhook endpoint that verifies event signatures and fulfills orders; use the Stripe CLI to forward events locally.

builder_notes: Keep STRIPE_SECRET_KEY on the server only; the publishable key is safe to expose to the client.
Verify webhook signatures before trusting any payment event and before fulfilling an order.
Use a Stripe-hosted Checkout Session rather than building a custom card form.
